title: Actual K-projective module models on affine opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open and $R=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$. Define $F_U:\mathrm{Mod}_R\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$ by tilde on $\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], restriction along $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R)$, and the equivalence with the localized site. For each strictly perfect complex $K$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] on that localized site, there exists a K-projective complex $P$ of $R$-modules and an actual complex isomorphism $F_U(P)\cong K$.

source.place: Tag 08CR, second proof; affine realization using Tag 06Z0 and the tilde adjunction (Tags 01I7 and 01HV)

proof.text: Construct the sheaf equivalence E by restriction along isoSpec.hom with inverse restriction along isoSpec.inv, using restrictFunctorComp and restrictFunctorId for unit and counit. Compose with overEquiv.inverse. Set F = tilde followed by E and H = E.inverse followed by moduleSpecGammaFunctor. Compose the tilde adjunction with E.toAdjunction.

Define P by applying H termwise to K. Identify F of every finite free module with the finite free sheaf via tildeFinsupp, restrictUnitIso, overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso and mapFreeIso. The counit is invertible on these sheaves, since the tilde unit and the E unit are invertible. Naturality makes its component on each retract K.X n a retract arrow of the free component. Isomorphisms are closed under retract arrows, so every counit component is invertible.

Applying H to each finite-free retract exhibits P.X n as a retract of a free module: H of the free sheaf is isomorphic to the free module by H.mapIso and the adjunction unit. Retract.projective gives projectivity of each term. H preserves zero objects, so the upper support bound of K gives IsStrictlyLE P b. Apply CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective. The termwise counit is an isomorphism of complexes by HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components, and mapHomologicalComplexIdIso identifies its target with K.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_perfect_module_model (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect X U K) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ,
      P.IsKProjective ∧
      Nonempty (((affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
        ≅ K)
